verdict.rationale: ClickHouse supports natural-language operation mainly through external AI assistants. It ships an official MCP server for connecting assistants, and clickhousectl can install official agent skills into coding agents. Its only first-party plain-language feature is AI Notebooks in ClickStack, where an agent queries logs, traces and metrics from a described issue, and that is waitlist-only. Missing for 10: a generally available first-party natural-language interface for operating the database itself (querying, admin, cluster management), documentation of how the MCP/skills handle NL-to-SQL, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
